title: Shape the website before we build
context: Choose the few decisions that change the design and implementation. The agent will use your saved answers as the working brief.

questions.prompt: What should the site feel like?
questions.why: This drives typography, color, spacing, imagery, and motion.

options.label: Quiet editorial
options.details: Strong typography, generous whitespace, restrained color, and subtle motion.
options.recommendation_reason: It creates a durable visual system and keeps the content—not decoration—as the focus.

options.label: Bold and playful
options.details: Saturated color, expressive type, larger shapes, and more visible animation.

options.label: Technical minimal
options.details: Dense grids, mono accents, compact spacing, and almost no decorative motion.

questions.why: The first-screen message determines the page hierarchy and primary call to action.

options.label: The outcome I deliver
options.details: Lead with the visitor's result, then support it with proof and process.
options.recommendation_reason: Outcome-first messaging is clearest for new visitors who do not yet know you.

options.label: My best work
options.details: Lead with a visual project gallery and let examples establish credibility.

options.label: My personal story
options.details: Lead with identity and background; useful when personality is the main differentiator.

questions.prompt: What belongs in the first release?
questions.why: A smaller launch is faster to polish; extra sections increase writing and testing work.

options.label: Home
options.details: Core proposition, proof, and primary call to action.
options.recommendation_reason: Every usable first release needs a clear entry point.

options.label: Projects
options.details: Selected case studies with outcomes and your contribution.

options.label: About
options.details: Background, working style, and a portrait or personal visual.

options.label: Writing
options.details: Articles or notes; valuable only if content is ready to maintain.

options.label: Contact
options.details: A focused conversion path with email, form, or booking link.
